epistemic_type: prospective design assumptions; source outcomes synthetic; no bank measured effect

input_contract.grain: comparison_registry subject/quarter; project deliverable root once; personal memberships separate
input_contract.units: hours are h; QA 0..100 penalty-редакция; ratios 0..1; usage distinct workflow runs per deliverable; money R
input_contract.worklog: diagnostic hours only; changing recorded hours cannot change gates/rank/money
input_contract.elapsed: status-time interval, not available capacity; never reward denominator
input_contract.capacity: (scheduled_hours-leave_hours-training_hours)*allocation_fraction shown diagnostically; scheduled already includes FTE; intervals never increase level
input_contract.prospective: rules and criteria approved before period; independently assigned complete scope; no outcome-dependent roster
input_contract.dedup: exact event copies once; all versions retain original root; repeat/correction not new benefit; missing root pending; project acceptance/use at deliverable grain once

quality.reuse: only existing compatible mature census acts; no new sample of20; accept correct subject/scope/period, penalty-редакция 0..100, independent checker, finalized<=quality_close and observation_end>=quality_close
quality.coverage: every original project case/part must have compatible one_distinct_case QA, OR an actually existing explicit same_deliverable_inspection act linked to its deliverable/root through source case_id/deliverable_id. Benefit dedup never broadens case QA scope. Flow cases/root links retained; same inspection_id counted once using worst penalty score
quality.score: max(0,100-2minor-10major-100critical), worst per unique inspection_id, mean of compatible independent frozen QA checklist acts; no derived extra inspection from child split
quality.critical: any compatible verified critical fail; missing/incomplete whole-register coverage pending, never infer absence from a small incompatible sample
quality.csat: diagnostic only; report n contacts, invitations, responses, 1..5 mean and topic/queue/shift source context; no responses=null; cannot substitute QA

recognition_categories.no_observed_penalty: all compatible distinct inspection worst-score100 in complete assigned census/checklist; mean100; rank2
recognition_categories.qualified_with_observed_penalty: same unchanged normal/stretch and mean>=99 but<100; at least one verified noncritical penalty; rank1
recognition_categories.interpretation: Observed full-portfolio recognition categories, not statistical confidence or future-quality estimates. No within-category ranking by decimal mean.

missing.real_fail: not_earned only independently observed violation of absolute condition; never move qualification to another quarter
missing.own_exposure: insufficient/not_earned; current fixed window0, next fixed annual window only
missing.missing_evidence: pending; hold conditional maximum; no imputed success, fail or quality0
missing.lost_source: source_incident/pending; restored proof earns original window/date, no expiry; known gap before start not_computable/uncovered route
missing.late: actual acceptance/use after quality_close is true late result, not delayed source delivery; unavailable evidence pending until known
missing.rank_unknown: hold group top at maximum rather than award an easier rank; normal guarantee independent of rank

signature.factual: source result and QA owner independent of ALL members of awarded team and team ID/control chain
signature.posting: Only actual required action with valid signed_at, source_ref=period:beneficiary, nonempty independent editor/signer/operator and specified distinct role pairs authorizes U. All awarded team members and every explicitly provided reporting_to dependency are excluded; no signature or type_correction alone=>pending conditional reserve, never sanctioned U or actual ledger posting.
signature.conflict: missing/invalid posting review => authorization pending, calculated qualification separately retained; valid independent review=>authorized U, actual ledger posting still absent. Alternate names never performed signature; held share not redistributed
signature.package: employee/window/cohort; source version/hash/record refs; role rule version; exposure; QA scope/inspection IDs; normal/stretch/rank/tie; benefit/root ID; R; independent verifier and nonrecipient HR posting signature
signature.business_config_projection: package_source_digest includes public_business_configs=the complete actual PUBLIC_CONFIGS list, with every config_id/version/field. Any content/version/order change requires a new matching award signature, even if resulting rank is unchanged. The award rows and their approvals_audit manifest stay excluded to avoid self-signing cycles; physical audit count/SHA is still checked.
signature.source_review_time: Personal and team performed source-completeness review must have valid nonempty signed_at and source_ref=own period:beneficiary; signed_at >= own quality_close_at, or quality_close at00:00+03 when no time is specified. Same stamp semantics for both; earlier/missing/invalid team action cannot authorize U.

rank.scope: within frozen comparable family/group only; no interprofessional Q/impact score
rank.money: 150*n_unique_persons; registered group<2 units top0; only stretch eligible; four slots40/30/20/10; absent slots unissued
rank.tie: equal rank keys tie; positions r..r+k-1 pool all intersecting fixed slots1..4 / k, even ties beyond4; apply predeclared contribution shares; floor only final personal R; unallocated share/remainder unissued
rank.uncertain: any unresolved ordinary result/stage stretch evidence => group top pending, personal normal independent; personal signature conflict reserves that share only
rank.precision: Fixed prospective categories, independent of other contestants: zero observed compatible penalties outranks qualified portfolio with observed penalties. Mean99 remains exact unchanged stretch threshold; no sorted-neighbor distances, decimal QA tie-breaks, rounding, or chaining. One new verified minor at100 crosses the substantive zero-observed-penalty boundary; cash may jump. Means99/99.05/99.9545 tie if eligible. This is not full continuity or proof that0.045 points predict better future quality.

evaluation: evaluator.py evaluate(data,spec) uses only public expanded tables; IDs label output, never choose rules; run() writes own CSVs; no source mutation
normal: All absolute role conditions; project all roots independently accepted and used by prospective business deadline, type-specific actual use: workflow>=1 distinct run, analytical1 named decision; planned workflow100 is diagnostic, not a normal volume gate. No quotas.
stretch: UNCHANGED: Normal plus compatible quality>=99 with complete coverage. Flow>=20 independent inspections across>=10 distinct event dates; project>=1 whole root/stage, all original parts or actual whole-act. Ranking uses fixed observed-penalty categories only.

batch_protocol.award_signature: input_correction_and_posting_review binds exact period/person plus immutable proposed decision package hash and rule version; no such new signature presumed in public source
batch_protocol.invalidation: roster/member SHA mismatch, missing performed action, wrong scope or conflict -> pending; hold original calculated entitlement and pool; corrections new package version; idempotency key employee/window/benefit/channel/quarter/version with replacement delta not second original award
batch_protocol.note: public source has composition metadata and source reviews; awards not posted by this analytical evaluator

project_business_config: unique prospective version1 matching group/period/work_type; conflicting post-start version pending; analytical pre-read readiness reported in business context but not reward rank; full root QA not necessarily many independent projects
